summary: Advances the dword pointer at a1 by 4 bytes and returns the 32-bit value that was stored just before the advance.

operations.description: Increment the pointer value stored at a1 by 4 (one dword).
Dereference the location four bytes before the new pointer value and return it as a 32-bit value.
